tasks.name: Semantic Analysis of Sentences
tasks.description: Analyze a sentence to extract its semantic meaning by identifying thematic roles and relationships between words and the central action or verb
tasks.given: The input sentence contains a verb and associated words that can be categorized into semantic roles
tasks.makes: The agent can draw correct inferences from the meaning representation

tasks.name: Lexical and Syntactic Analysis
tasks.description: Categorize words into lexical categories and identify the grammatical structure of the sentence
tasks.given: Sentence is provided as input text
tasks.makes: Words are categorized and sentence structure is identified

tasks.name: Semantic Role Assignment
tasks.description: Assign words to thematic roles based on their semantic relationship to the central verb
tasks.given: Syntactic structure is available and semantic categories are defined
tasks.makes: Each relevant word is assigned to appropriate thematic role slots

tasks.name: Frame Construction and Inference
tasks.description: Build complete frame representation and enable inference generation from the frame
tasks.makes: Frame representation enables correct inferences about unstated information

tasks.name: Verb Disambiguation
tasks.description: Resolve ambiguous verb meanings by selecting the correct interpretation from multiple possible meanings using contextual constraints
tasks.given: A verb has multiple possible meanings represented by different thematic role frames
tasks.makes: Only one frame remains active that correctly captures the verb's meaning

tasks.name: Apply Disambiguation Constraints
tasks.description: Apply object, preposition, and particle constraints to eliminate incompatible frame interpretations
tasks.given: Multiple candidate frames exist with contextual information available
tasks.makes: Constraint application reduces candidates to one correct frame
